Dark red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Night 'n' Day
Exhibition name: Night 'n' Day
rows.Bloom: Dark red. Flowers very dark red to black outer petals and bright red petals in the central portion of the flowers. Strong, sweet, tea fragrance. Average diameter 4.5". Medium-large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form. Continuous (perpetual) bloom throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Tall, armed with thorns / prickles, upright.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower or garden. Very vigorous. flowers drop off cleanly.
